info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Alkaline Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Alkaline Produce Catalog Management API facilitates the creation and management of alkaline produce details within an inventory system. This endpoint allows users to submit new entries for various alkaline produce items, ensuring that catalog information is accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers of this API include inventory managers, e-commerce platforms, and agricultural businesses looking to maintain comprehensive product catalogs. By utilizing this API, organizations enhance product visibility and streamline inventory processes.

post.summary: Create a new alkaline produce detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail entry for alkaline produce, providing essential information necessary for inventory management and tracking. Ensure that all required fields are filled in the request body for successful creation.

requestBody.description: A request body that contains the necessary details to create or update information regarding alkaline produce. The body must conform to the specified schema, ensuring that all required fields are present for successful processing.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.
